code/rust/pfp/src/foundation.rs: PrimitiveDifference is a freely constructible nullary witness with no carrier or derivation of mathematical structure. Name/digest gates are lexical; canonical JSON delegates to the runtime exact typed encoder. require_nonnegative assumes valid normalized BigRational input and does not check zero denominators. Module is explicitly additive and outside consequential host protocol. Local manufactured Result-tag test exercises none of these owners; golden correspondence is a dependency claim, not proved here.
code/rust/pfp/src/certifiers.rs: Strict request DTO parses exact rational coboundaries and delegates Phi1 primal-dual verification to core_certifiers::Phi1FormCertificate. Parse failures are outer Err, checker refusals accepted=false outcomes; output hardcodes a Lean theorem name and AuthorityEffect None. The wrapper does not check Lean artifacts, prove extraction correspondence or bind to a task's intended quotient. Local tests cover only the unrelated shared count/capacity template.
code/rust/pfp/src/wdp_kernel.rs: Requires exactly model/certificate object fields and delegates bounded WDP replay to core_wdp application_kernel. Emits model/certificate digests, compile-time checker source hash and AuthorityEffect None. Source hash authenticates one included file, not all dependencies or proof correspondence. Local tests only shared capacity arithmetic; semantic guarantees reside in external checker.
code/rust/pfp/src/arms.rs: Nonempty arm list compares exact strings for model/temperature/specification and integers for max tokens/budget. Singleton passes. Does not validate unique arm IDs, valid spec digests, positive budgets or the public authority_effect string despite comment claiming const None; no statistics are computed here. Matching declared controls is not experimental randomization, provenance or statistical adequacy. Only manufactured Ok/Err local test.
code/rust/pfp_runtime/src/refusal.rs: Public refusal DTO constructor trims/NFC-normalizes message only; direct fields/Deserialize can bypass that normalization. Private DiagnosticWeight certifies checked byte-length(code)+Unicode-scalar-count(message)+number-of-details <= positive budget, with nonblank whitespace-free code. Detail key/value sizes and locus do not contribute, so this is the declared metric, not a serialized byte/resource bound. Actual tests cover total18, small-budget refusal and spaced code.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/sealed.rs: Public Sealed marker has no methods; SealedPayload privately owns nonempty bytes and verifies supplied length equals actual length, exposing immutable slices. Redundant postconstruction check adds no stronger theorem. Tests exercise admitted payload, empty and mismatched length. This establishes payload ownership/length, not cryptographic sealing, freshness or authority; trait reachability depends on crate module visibility.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/no_authorit: NoAuthorityGuard reads a caller-implemented AuthorityTagged effect once and accepts only None. Tests accept diagnostic None and reject constructed Certified metadata. NoneOnlyItem hardcodes None with merely nonempty ID (whitespace allowed); batch verifies nonempty collection and unique IDs, retaining only count. It cannot detect undeclared effects or bind later artifact behavior; batch tests cover two IDs and duplicate refusal.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/three_role_: Explicit policy over declared identifiers: trimmed-nonempty identities, configurable proposer/evaluator/authorizer equality refusal, Certificate enum rather than Prose, and supplied admitted-root membership distinct from proposer/evaluator. No certificate-chain verification or identity binding; documentation correctly discloses identity caveat. Public receipt has no cryptographic authority. Packet digest omits policy, so it is a packet identity not a full policy-check receipt. compose_attempts checks each independent attempt and returns last receipt, not a provenance chain. Tests exercise self-authorization, missing/prose/external roots and refused sequence.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/descriptors: Reexports binding/law/product-spine declarations; private AuthorityCeilingWitness checks supplied u8 ranks in0..6 and declared<=ceiling, retaining checked slack. No binding of rank to actual action or authorization is established. Local test manufactures Result tags and does not invoke this predicate.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/enforcement: Module routing plus private AdmittedSpend verifies nonempty positive u64 costs, checked sum<=positive initial and restored balance. Exact finite budget arithmetic, independent of actual charges, reservation concurrency or external execution. Tests valid remainder and overspend; overflow/zero gates source reviewed but not directly tested locally.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/traits_iden: NamedComponent/ContractBound expose static metadata. schema_agrees checks nonempty names/IDs and equal optional schemas only when contract IDs match; different IDs pass and both None pass. It checks lexical slot consistency, not schema contents, semantic identity or contract enforcement. Tests conflicting schemas and different IDs.
code/rust/pfp/src/foundation/dda.rs: Private DDA events validate names, exact JSON parameters, nonnegative declared obstruction values, unique projection/loss labels and endpoint equality of each supplied protected projection. No operation or obstruction evaluation occurs at record time; empty projection lists are allowed and undeclared losses cannot be detected. Paths validate exact state joins, common context/task/source labels, unique event IDs and parent adjacency; identity and concatenation implement partial finite-path composition. Replay executes caller resolver and compares every after state, but does not recompute obstruction/projection semantics or prove callback purity. Eq excludes bare floats but does not prove arbitrary state semantics. No owner local tests beyond exact shared capacity template.
code/rust/pfp/src/foundation/repair.rs: ExactFiniteDetector is a caller-declared nonnegative rational lookup table; DeclaredRepairUniverse validates identities but does not establish external completeness or execute repair operations. ExhaustionCertificate checks full ordered candidate evaluation census against result-state table lookups and computes min including source, so empty universe certifies only supplied declaration. Hash binds candidate IDs/values and labels but not candidate result-state mapping or whole detector table. R1 has priority at zero, else private R2 license with residual; if only source is zero selected candidate list is empty by design. No universal detector adequacy or global search claim. Local tests only shared capacity template.
code/rust/pfp/src/foundation/packet.rs: Private PacketKernel admits exact typed-canonical JSON, nonblank trimmed contract/task names and optional lowercase64hex parent; identity is framed SHA256 of four-field canonical material. Structural equality compares bytes, not digest alone. Semantic equality requires explicit caller projection, then compares canonical projected values; projection identity is only diagnostic and no purity/completeness/contract applicability law is checked. Generic caller can define degenerate semantics intentionally. Parent existence/custody is external. Local tests only unrelated capacity template.
code/rust/pfp/src/foundation/extension.r: Finite extension witness checks unique old/new sample lists, lifted membership, forget(lift(x))=x and exact nonnegative detector equality on every declared old point. This is finite sample evidence under extensional/pure callbacks, not proof of global contexts. Candidate evaluation checks context labels, positive cardinality growth and result membership, but receives a new unbound detector callable distinct from that used for preservation; it can report zero on a preserved positive old point. Family assessment binds only context/source strings to exhaustion, prioritizes R1, and minimizes added-point count among supplied zero-valued candidates, retaining ties. No global minimality, causal operation or source-state membership proof. Shared capacity tests do not exercise these owners. Detector-consistency counterexample pending bounded probe.
